library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)

library(ggfortify)

```{r heather, include=FALSE}
setwd("C:/Users/shaan/Documents/Shiny Dashboard (R Project)")
data <- as_tibble(read.csv("heather.csv", header=TRUE))

dataGrouped <- data %>%
  group_by(Year, Treat) %>%
  summarise(Heather = mean(Heather),
            Exotic.dicots = mean(Exotic.dicots),
            Exotic.monocots = mean(Exotic.monocots),
            Native.dicots = mean(Native.dicots),
            Native.monocots = mean(Native.monocots),
            Bryophytes = mean(Bryophytes),
            Lichen = mean(Lichen),
            Clubmoss = mean(Clubmoss),
            bare = mean(bare),
            litter = mean(litter))

dataGrouped <- tsibble(dataGrouped, key=Treat, index=Year) # index is for the time series

##---- predictPlant(): return a vector of predict value for a given plant and all four treatments ----##
predictPlant <- function(var, year){
  model <- lm(var ~ Treat*Year, data=dataGrouped)
  pred_list <- rep(0, 4)
  predictTreat <- c("B", "H", "HB", "C")
  for (i in 1:4){
    new_data.Plant <- data.frame(Year=year, Treat=predictTreat[i])
    predicted_Plant <- predict(model, newdata=new_data.Plant)
    pred_list[i] <- predicted_Plant
  }
  # returns a vector of the predicted plant value for each treatment at a given year
  pred_list
}

##---- predictPlantDF(): return a tsibble df of four rows (treatments) and 12 columns (plants) ----##
predictPlantDF <- function(year){
  new.df <- data.frame(Year = rep(year, 4),
                       Treat = c("B", "H", "HB", "C"),
                       Heather = predictPlant(dataGrouped$Heather, year)[1:4],
                       Exotic.dicots = predictPlant(dataGrouped$Exotic.dicots, year)[1:4],
                       Exotic.monocots = predictPlant(dataGrouped$Exotic.monocots, year)[1:4],
                       Native.dicots = predictPlant(dataGrouped$Native.dicots, year)[1:4],
                       Native.monocots = predictPlant(dataGrouped$Native.monocots, year)[1:4],
                       Bryophytes = predictPlant(dataGrouped$Bryophytes, year)[1:4],
                       Lichen = predictPlant(dataGrouped$Lichen, year)[1:4],
                       Clubmoss = predictPlant(dataGrouped$Clubmoss, year)[1:4],
                       bare = predictPlant(dataGrouped$bare, year)[1:4],
                       litter = predictPlant(dataGrouped$litter, year)[1:4])
  #creates a new tsibble of 4 rows (one for each treatment) and 12 columns (for the different variables)
  tsibble(new.df, key=Treat, index=Year)
}

colours <- c("Heather" = "#d091e5", "Native.dicots" = "#af3d08", "Native.monocots"="#d5e062",
             "Exotic.dicots"="#38d6c8", "Exotic.monocots"="#08af3d", "Bryophytes"="#fea035", 
             "Lichen"="#ddff9d", "Clubmoss"="#ee6cdc", "bare"="#a4a3a2", "litter"="#5c3711")

for(i in 2013:2050){
  dataGrouped <- bind_rows(dataGrouped, predictPlantDF(i))
}
```
```{r ui}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Estimation of Plant Groundcover at Tongariro"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(inputId = "userPlant",
                  label = "Select what plant to estimate",
                  choices = c("Heather", "Exotic.dicots", "Exotic.monocots", "Native.dicots",
                              "Native.monocots", "Bryophytes", "Lichen", "Clubmoss",
                              "bare", "litter"), selected="Heather"),
      sliderInput(inputId = "userYear",
                  label = "Select the year you want to estimate",
                  min=2013, max=2050, value=2013)
    ),
    mainPanel(plotOutput("plot"),
              tableOutput("table")
              )
  )
)
```
```{r server}
server <- function(input, output){
  output$table <- renderTable({
    rt <- cbind(dataGrouped["Year"], dataGrouped["Treat"], dataGrouped[input$userPlant])
    rt[rt$Year==input$userYear,]
  })
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
      dataGrouped <- dataGrouped %>%
        filter(Year <= input$userYear)
      if(input$userPlant=="Heather"){p <- ggplot(dataGrouped, aes(Year, 100*Heather))}
      if(input$userPlant=="Exotic.dicots"){p <- ggplot(dataGrouped, aes(Year, 100*Exotic.dicots))}
      if(input$userPlant=="Exotic.monocots"){p <- ggplot(dataGrouped, aes(Year, 100*Exotic.monocots))}
      if(input$userPlant=="Native.dicots"){p <- ggplot(dataGrouped, aes(Year, 100*Native.dicots))}
      if(input$userPlant=="Native.monocots"){p <- ggplot(dataGrouped, aes(Year, 100*Native.monocots))}
      if(input$userPlant=="Bryophytes"){p <- ggplot(dataGrouped, aes(Year, 100*Bryophytes))}
      if(input$userPlant=="Lichen"){p <- ggplot(dataGrouped, aes(Year, 100*Lichen))}
      if(input$userPlant=="Clubmoss"){p <- ggplot(dataGrouped, aes(Year, 100*Clubmoss))}
      if(input$userPlant=="bare"){p <- ggplot(dataGrouped, aes(Year, 100*bare))}
      if(input$userPlant=="litter"){p <- ggplot(dataGrouped, aes(Year, 100*litter))}
      p + geom_line(aes(linetype=Treat, colour=input$userPlant)) +
      labs(title=paste("Average Proportion of", input$userPlant," under Treatments"),
           y="Average Groundcover (%)") +
      ylim(0, 100) +
      geom_vline(xintercept=2012) +
      scale_colour_manual(values=colours) +
      annotate("text", x=2009, y=80, label="Actual data") +
      annotate("text", x=(2013 + (input$userYear-2013)/2), y=80, label="Predicted data") +
      theme_minimal()
  })
}
```
```{r shinyAppInit}
shinyApp(ui=ui, server=server)
```
